answer_1.quote: Summarizing texts around an open-aspect is a basic necessity when consuming information. Our new OPENASP benchmark serves this demand, as the first open ABS dataset in the multi-document setting, with high-quality summaries collected via an efficient protocol.

answer_2.quote: We apply the commonly used ROUGE metrics, which measure the lexical overlap between the system and reference aspect-based summaries.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a manual evaluation on the summaries produced by the three top-scoring models: ChatGPT Recursive, ChatGPT Summ, and BART Summ, with the latter two using the Sentence-T5 sentence selector. For 20 random instances from the OPENASP test set, we assessed: (1) Relevance to the aspect, i.e., "is the target aspect adequately discussed in the system summary?"; and (2) Relevance to the Reference summary, i.e., "does the system summary refer to the information in the aspect-based reference summary?" . Each criterion was rated on a 1-5 scale.
answer_4.guideline: is the target aspect adequately discussed in the system summary? and does the system summary refer to the information in the aspect-based reference summary?
